summary: Artisan Hub marketplace for a sole trader to sell original creations with bulk image upload, AI-generated descriptions, and Stripe payment processing
architectural_notes: Direct Stripe integration without commission handling
Each uploaded image becomes a separate product listing
Focus on product management, no customer management features
Inline editing in dashboard list view for product management
Shopping basket uses temporary cart/session storage for multi-item purchases
Stripe integration supports both single-item and multi-item checkout flows
Bulk upload uses manual description input by default, with AI generation as optional feature
Bulk upload auto-copy feature copies title, price, inventory count, and category from first item to subsequent items, triggered by user control (button/checkbox)
Stripe checkout handles all shipping and billing information collection, platform does not collect shipping details
Home page dynamically fetches and displays product statistics (featured, most viewed, most sold, newest) from backend
known_issues: Images fail to persist when creating products through bulk upload interface
Product images fail to load properly on marketplace page
Marketplace filter UI changed to dropdown icon instead of static button tabs
Add to Cart functionality is failing with error message when attempting to add items to shopping cart

existing_features.title: Create bulk image upload interface that allows uploading multiple images at once, assigns all images to a single selected category, and automatically creates one product per uploaded image
Build product management dashboard showing all product listings with ability to edit, delete, and view product details including images, descriptions, pricing, and inventory status

Build immediate checkout flow for customers that allows selecting a product, entering shipping information, and completing payment via Stripe without requiring account creation
Create public marketplace storefront displaying all available products with images, titles, categories, prices, and the ability for customers to browse and select products for purchase
Create Terms and Conditions page and Privacy Policy page with footer component that links to both pages from all site pages
Design a creative visual theme with distinctive colors, typography, and layout style that reflects an artisan handmade marketplace aesthetic and apply it consistently across all pages

Fix the bulk upload image persistence bug where product images fail to save when creating new products through the bulk upload interface. Ensure images are properly stored in the backend blob storage and associated with newly created products.

Update the HomepageSettings component (frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings.tsx) to add a new 'Hero Background Image' upload field that allows the trader to upload a custom background image showcasing 3D printed ocarinas for the marketplace hero section

Investigate and fix the product image loading issue in the Marketplace page (frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx) where product images fail to display properly by verifying the image URL construction, blob storage retrieval, and ProductCard image rendering logic

Verify and fix the ProductCard component (frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx) image rendering to ensure it correctly handles image URLs from the backend, includes proper error handling for failed image loads, and displays a fallback placeholder if image loading fails

Add drag-and-drop functionality to the ProductManagementTable component (frontend/src/components/ProductManagementTable.tsx) allowing admin users to reorder products by dragging and dropping table rows. Add visual indicators to the ProductManagementTable component showing when drag-and-drop reordering is available versus when it is disabled due to active shape filters. Display a message or tooltip explaining that drag-and-drop reordering is only available when viewing all products without filters.

Add an 'Ocarina Music Studio' navigation link to the main header navigation bar in the Layout component (frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx) that is visible to all visitors (both authenticated and unauthenticated), linking to the new /ocarina-studio route.
Register a new /ocarina-studio route in frontend/src/App.tsx pointing to the new OcarinaStudio page component.

Create a new OcarinaStudio page component (frontend/src/pages/OcarinaStudio.tsx) that fetches all products from the backend using the existing useProducts React Query hook and displays each product as a studio card with the product image, title, description, and assigned pitch scale (Bass Low C3–C4, Bass C4–C5, Alto C5–C6, Soprano C6–C7). Each card must include a 'Play Demo' button, a 'Play Ocarina' button, and a 'Buy Now' link that navigates to the marketplace product detail for that item.

Implement a Web Audio API ocarina sound synthesis utility (frontend/src/utils/ocarinaSynth.ts) that generates ocarina-like tones using the browser's built-in AudioContext. The utility must support four pitch scales — Bass Low (C3–C4), Bass (C4–C5), Alto (C5–C6), and Soprano (C6–C7) — and expose: (1) a function to play a short auto-generated demo tone sequence spanning the assigned pitch range, and (2) a function to play a single note by frequency. Use sine and triangle wave oscillators blended with a gain envelope (attack/decay/sustain/release) to approximate an ocarina timbre. No audio file uploads are required.

Implement the 'Play Demo' button behaviour on each OcarinaStudio product card: when clicked, use the ocarinaSynth utility to play a short auto-generated demo tone sequence (ascending and descending scale) tuned to the pitch range assigned to that ocarina. Show a visual 'playing…' indicator while the demo is playing and revert to the default state when the sequence ends.

Implement the 'Play Ocarina' button behaviour on each OcarinaStudio product card: when clicked, open an interactive on-screen ocarina panel (inline or modal) displaying the playable notes available within the assigned pitch scale. Render each note as a labelled button (e.g., C4, D4, E4… up to the top of the range). When a note button is pressed, use the ocarinaSynth utility to play that note's tone via Web Audio API. The panel must include a close/dismiss control to return to the product card view.

Create React Query hooks in `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts` for the new payment settings data: `useDiscountCodes()` (fetches all codes, admin-authenticated), `useCreateDiscountCode()`, `useUpdateDiscountCode()`, `useDeleteDiscountCode()` mutations (all admin-authenticated with cache invalidation), `useValidateDiscountCode()` mutation (public, no auth required), `usePaymentSettings()` (fetches bonus item config and pro app URL), and `useUpdatePaymentSettings()` mutation (admin-authenticated).

Add a 'Payment Settings' tab to the admin Dashboard page (`frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`). This tab must contain three sections: (1) **Discount Codes** — a table listing all existing promo codes (code, type, value, active status) with Edit and Delete buttons per row, plus a 'Create New Code' form with fields for code string, type selector (Percentage Off / Fixed Amount), value input, and active toggle; (2) **Bonus Item** — a form with fields for bonus item title, description, URL, and an enabled toggle; (3) **Pro Ocarina Learning App** — a single URL input field labelled 'Pro Ocarina Learning App URL'. All sections use the corresponding React Query hooks from REQ-129.

Add a discount code entry field to the Checkout page (`frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx`). Display an input labelled 'Promo Code' with an 'Apply' button. When applied, call `useValidateDiscountCode()` to validate the code: if valid, display the discount amount and update the displayed order total accordingly; if invalid or inactive, show an inline error message. Pass the validated discount code value to the Stripe checkout session creation call so the discount is reflected in the Stripe session line items or coupon.

Update the Payment Success page (`frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx`) to display the configured bonus item and Pro Ocarina Learning App URL after a successful purchase. Fetch payment settings using `usePaymentSettings()`. If the bonus item is enabled, display its title, description, and a clearly labelled link/button to access the bonus item URL. Always display a dedicated section for the Pro Ocarina Learning App with a labelled link to the configured URL (e.g. 'Access your free Pro Ocarina Learning App'). If the Pro Ocarina App URL is not yet configured, do not display that section.

Add static free postage and no returns policy notices to three locations in the frontend: (1) **Product Detail View** (`frontend/src/components/ProductDetailView.tsx`) — add a notice below the price reading '✓ Free postage on every order' and '✗ No returns accepted'; (2) **Checkout page** (`frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx`) — add a policy summary box in the order summary section stating 'Free postage included' and 'No returns policy applies to all purchases'; (3) **Payment Success page** (`frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx`) — add a brief reminder 'Your order includes free postage. Please note: no returns are accepted.' These notices are static text and do not require backend configuration.

Update the Terms & Conditions page (`frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx`) to add or update the following policy sections: (1) **Shipping** — state that free postage is included on every order with no minimum purchase required; (2) **Returns** — replace any existing returns text with a clear no-returns policy statement explaining all sales are final and no returns or refunds are accepted; (3) **Digital Inclusions** — add a new section stating that every purchase includes complimentary access to the Pro Ocarina Learning App, a digital tool for learning ocarina tablature and composing music.

Update the Privacy Policy page (`frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx`) to add or update the following sections: (1) **Order Fulfillment** — note that free postage is provided on all orders and no personal shipping cost data is collected for postage calculations; (2) **Digital Products & App Access** — add a section explaining that purchase records may be used to grant access to the Pro Ocarina Learning App, a digital learning tool included with every order; (3) **Returns & Refunds** — add a statement that no returns or refunds are processed, so no return-related personal data is collected.

Update the BulkProductUpload component (frontend/src/components/BulkProductUpload.tsx) to set the default selected template in the template dropdown to the 'Default' template (from REQ-136) when the component first loads, replacing the previously hardcoded description string. When the user changes the selected template from the dropdown, all product description fields that have not been manually edited should update to display the newly selected template's content. The four shape-specific templates (Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale) must appear as selectable options in the same dropdown alongside the Default template.

Update the BulkProductUpload component (frontend/src/components/BulkProductUpload.tsx) to automatically select the matching shape-specific description template for each product based on its shape field value. When a product's shape is set to 'Turtle', 'Dolphin', 'Frog', or 'Whale', automatically apply the corresponding named template (Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, or Whale) to that product's description field. When the shape is set to any other value or is blank, fall back to the 'Default' template. This auto-selection should trigger whenever the shape field changes for a product, and should update the description field with the matched template's content unless the user has manually edited that description field.
